question: how many items are out of stock, all dates
normalised: how many items out stock all dates
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS out_of_stock_item_count
FROM v_out_of_stock_items

question: what is the current stock of silica sand in qcl
sql:
SELECT s.item_code, s.item_name, s.branch, s.available_qty, i.default_unit_of_measurement AS uom
FROM stock s
LEFT JOIN items i ON i.item_code = s.item_code
WHERE s.item_code IN ('23556-60', '2951-147')
  AND s.branch ILIKE '%Qadcast%'

question: what is the status of silica sand
sql:
WITH stock_position AS (
    SELECT
        s.item_code,
        COUNT(*) AS branches_held_at,
        SUM(s.stock_qty) AS stock_qty,
        SUM(s.hold_qty) AS hold_qty,
        SUM(s.available_qty) AS available_qty,
        SUM(s.available_amount) AS available_amount
    FROM stock s
    WHERE s.item_code IN ('23556-60', '2951-147')
    GROUP BY s.item_code
)
SELECT
    i.item_code,
    i.name AS item_name,
    i.default_unit_of_measurement AS uom,
    sp.branches_held_at,
    sp.stock_qty,
    sp.hold_qty,
    sp.available_qty,
    sp.available_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN sp.item_code IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE sp.available_qty <= 0
    END AS is_out_of_stock
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN stock_position sp ON sp.item_code = i.item_code
WHERE i.item_code IN ('23556-60', '2951-147')
ORDER BY i.item_code
